body.name: \mathcal I_K(r)
body.construction: For \(K\ge2\), put \(I_{Kj}=((j-1)/K,j/K]\), with \(0\in I_{K1}\), and \(B_{Kj}=[j/K-K^{-3},j/K+K^{-3}]\) for \(1\le j<K\). For \(\theta\in\mathcal T_K(r)\), define \(g_{d,K,\theta}(u)=p_{d,\kappa_K(u)}\) off \(\bigcup_{j<K}B_{Kj}\); on \(B_{Kj}\), let \(g_{d,K,\theta}\) be the affine function joining \(p_{dj}\) at \(j/K-K^{-3}\) to \(p_{d,j+1}\) at \(j/K+K^{-3}\). The experiment \(\mathfrak I_K(\theta)\) observes independent arms with \(U_{di}\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\operatorname{Unif}[0,1]\) and conditionally independent \(Y_{di}\mid U_{di}=u\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(g_{d,K,\theta}(u))\). Set \(\mathcal I_K(r)=\{\mathfrak I_K(\theta):\theta\in\mathcal T_K(r)\}\). The measurable pushforward \(\mathsf Q_K\) replaces every \(U_{di}\) by \(\kappa_K(U_{di})\).
